headline: Roosevelt dies at Sagamore Hill
summary: Around a quarter past four in the morning, Theodore Roosevelt dies in his sleep at Sagamore Hill of a coronary embolism. Archie wires his brothers Ted and Kermit in Europe that the old lion is dead. About a hundred dignitaries and Oyster Bay schoolchildren attend a plain funeral, with no music, and he is buried in Youngs Cemetery.

events.detail: Dies in his sleep from a blood clot in the heart

tr_quotes.text: Home, wife, children, they are what really count in my life. I have heartily enjoyed many things; the Presidency, my success as a soldier, a writer, a big game hunter and explorer; but all of them put together are not for one moment to be weighed in the balence when compared with the joy I have known with your Mother and all of you

uncertain: The family quote is undated in the record, and "balence" is kept as printed. The record also lists endocarditis. The funeral and burial were January 8, though the record places them here.
